EmailTemplate.subject: ITA L2 - CO - Pay Period Change
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName}
We understand that you are interested in changing your pay period structure from CURRENT SCHEDULE to NEW SCHEDULE. In order to determine the extent of this change, and ensure proper setup, we have a few questions:
Do you have an example of the new schedule for this structure?
When is the proposed start date for utilizing the new pay period structure?
Has this change been discussed with an Insperity Payroll Specialist?
Is this a site-wide change or will it impact only certain pay groups?
If only for certain pay groups, please detail which pay groups will be impacted.
How many employees will be involved in the change?
Do you import pay group assignments from your HR software or a file feed?
Do you have accruals that are based on a per-period award?
If so, will rates need to be adjusted?
Do any of these changes involve moving toward or discontinuing a pay current arrangement (pay check is cut on or before the pay period end date)?
Thank you in advance for providing this information. Once it is received, a member of our team will determine the next steps and a representative will be in touch as soon as they are able.
Thank you,
Technical Support Team
8401 Greenway Blvd. Suite 1100 | Middleton, WI 53562 OFFICE: 800-314-8223 | FAX: 262-364-3800
